response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT a.translink) AS transaction_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = a.translink JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY t.tradekind), type_stats AS (SELECT transaction_count, transaction_count::numeric / SUM(transaction_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(transaction_count::numeric) OVER () AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT SUM(transaction_count) AS sum_of_counts, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(transaction_count - average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_stats WHERE transaction_count > average_count
